Also the first caption "设备 · 已连接 / 电量 / 配件 / 星历" — the first phone's caption should presumably be under the left phone (phone 1 center ~252), and the second under right phone (center ~587). But the combined line starts at x~95 and ends x~815, centered under the phone pair roughly. Actually caption 1 spans "设备...星历" x~95-425, centered ~260 — under left phone (center 252) ok. Caption 2 "记录回放...功率" x~430-815, center ~622 — under right phone (center 587) slightly right-shifted but not overflowing.

The gap between the two captions looks tiny (a few px). Let me crop and zoom to verify whether they collide.

{"command": "cd /tmp && python3 -I -c "
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im = np.array(Image.open('/home/jinsc/SDK/vela/ppt/.build/render19/s-10.png').convert('L'))
# left phone region approx x 90-420, right 420-760; frame is dark (<60)
def bbox(x0,x1,y0,y1):
    reg = im[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    ys, xs = np.where(reg < 60)
    return (x0+xs.min(), x0+xs.max(), y0+ys.min(), y0+ys.max())
l = bbox(80, 425, 230, 850)
r = bbox(425, 780, 230, 850)
for name,(x0,x1,y0,y1) in [('L',l),('R',r)]:
    print(name, 'x:',x0,x1,'y:',y0,y1,'w:',x1-x0,'h:',y1-y0,'AR: %.3f'%((y1-y0)/(x1-x0)))
"", "description": "Measure phone frame bounding boxes and aspect ratios"}
